text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, is this place for real!?
The out-of-place vibes are unreal!

As for why we are in a place like this...
It all started with a consultation
Nishino Flower brought to Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...And so, someone who saw the nail photo on Umatter
commented suggesting I make a bento
themed around nail art.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It sounds fun, so I want to try it, but...
I can't think of any stylish bento ideas.
What kind do you think would be good...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Something Insta-worthy?
Then how about this one that's been trending lately?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Japanese sweets...!
Packing these into a bento box would look so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Though... I haven't really made
jonamagashi before...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Joe-namagashi??
...Like, sweets made live on stream by Joe?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For now, let's ask someone who knows their sweets.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, why not take advantage of
a wagashi-making workshop?
They should be able to teach you how to make jonamagashi.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am also quite interested, so if you decide to go,
would it be acceptable if I joined you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then can you handle the reservation?
You seem like you know all about this, Flash-san.

And figuring an adult chaperone would be appropriate,
the spotlight fell upon me, who happened to be nearby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
One can truly feel the tradition and prestige here.
This promises to be an excellent wagashi-making experience.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: This seems totally impossible for me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's do our best!
Um... before making the sweets,
we have some wagashi and tea first, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A private room?! This is totally
that "splendid tea ceremony" stuff, right?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was also written in a Japanese culture book that Japanese sweets and the tea ceremony are inseparable.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion.
I shall now prepare the tea for you.

A staff member dressed in a kimono came over
and placed traditional Japanese sweets before each person.
Afterwards, they began whisking the tea.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text: Please feel free to enjoy the sweets whenever you like.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the sweets, I'll enjoy them now.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're eatin' already?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, according to etiquette,
I believe you're supposed to finish them before the tea is served.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that seems to be the case.
I was surprised to learn that when reading about it in a book as well.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Flower-chan, you know so much about this!
I'm totally clueless, so teach me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
While I studied the tea ceremony, I am still slightly uneasy...
Flower-san, would you mind instructing me as well?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...! But um,
I never formally learned it or anything, so...
I'm sorry if I get something wrong!

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you're super reliable, Flower-chan.
Knowing all about tea ceremony is mad respect~.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you all are wonderful as well.
Humbly asking to learn from someone younger than yourself
is not something everyone can easily do.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you young ladies are wonderful as well.
Humbly asking to learn from someone younger than yourself
is not something everyone can easily do.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Uhh...? Did I just get praised...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they praised your willingness to learn!
Yep, they praised your willingness to learn!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me if I overstepped.
Please, relax and make yourselves comfortable.
This is a hands-on experience, so we hope you simply have fun.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Then, is it cool if I take pictures?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wha... Jordan-san,
surely taking photos is a bit too much...!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, please feel free to take pictures.
We would be delighted if it helps spark your interest
in wagashi and Japanese tea.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too...!
Please let me take a picture of the sweets!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The wagashi-making experience was exceedingly worthwhile.
Through these traditional sweets, I was able to deepen
my understanding of Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally, it's not something you get to do every day,
so it was pretty fun.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They even taught us how to make high-grade namagashi,
so I feel like I can make a really cute wagashi bento now!

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you wanna do elaborate nail art, I can teach ya.
Just hit me up, 'kay?

Afterwards, the three of them continued brainstorming ideas
for Nishino Flower's Umatter photos, having a wonderful time.

The whisking of the tea whisk echoed in the silence. Glancing aside,
Tousen Jordan and Eishin Flash both had strained,
pained expressions on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow~~! Sitting seiza is pure torture!
My legs are so numb, it's crazy!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san, surely stretching right here
is rather ill-mannered.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who cares, it's just us here anyway~.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Besides, your legs are totally numb too, Flash-san~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
~~~~~~~~gh!!
P-Please do not poke me...!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you cross your big toes into a slight V-shape
and leave some space between your legs when you sit,
it helps keep your legs from falling asleep.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, for real. That's legit so much easier~♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is how one sits.
As I am not accustomed to seiza, this is a great help.
Thank you, Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad I could help.
Even so, when it gets tough, you can simply say "excuse me"
and sit more casually, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, Flower-chan is so dependable~. A total lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wawa, goodness, you're making me blush...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san, if there are any flaws in my etiquette,
please do not hesitate to point them out.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... you don't really have to
worry about formal etiquette right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The staff stepped out of the room,
so I think they meant for us to relax...

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Prob'ly saw that we couldn't take seiza anymore
and read the room, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...! That is...
rather embarrassing, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Tousen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, let's take advantage of it and chill out!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Let's take our time
enjoying the tea and sweets.

While relaxing, we savored the tea and sweets.
Afterward, we experienced the intended wagashi-making,
and spent a truly wonderful time together.
